properties.notes: Vacant building, last utilised for retail and commercial uses, that had become semi-derelict in the years unoccupied. Located within an established residential area in Ashington. Identified for demolition and redevelopment a number of years ago. Initial permission was granted for 8 flats following clearance of the site (06/00263/FUL). This was then superseded by a revised proposal for construction of 6 dwellings (07/00412/FUL). Development largely completed some time ago, although 1 dwelling has yet to be built. Permission for this outstanding unit will not lapse, although this is not currently considered deliverable.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
